waning_light.title: The Waning Light
waning_light.intro:
Each evening the sun sets a little earlier than it should. Candles burn low and blue. Wells taste of iron. The old folk say the world's light is going out, and nobody believes them, except you.

You are {var.player_name}, a traveller with an empty purse and no particular destination, and you have stopped for the night in a quiet village at the edge of the wild.
waning_light.ending: And so the light returned. Songs would be sung about {var.player_name}, most of them wrong, all of them loud. But on quiet evenings, when the sun set exactly when it should, you would sit and watch it go down, and smile, and not say a word.

inventory.name: worn cloak
inventory.description: Your old travelling cloak, patched at both elbows.

waning_omen: For a moment the sun dims, as if a hand had passed across it.
Your shadow seems paler than it should be.
Somewhere a bell rings, flat and dull, as if the air were too thin to carry it.
The colours of the world look washed out today, like an old tapestry.
